Before GTA VI releases for everyone, let's remember how we got here.

$GTA6 launched on Solana on 29 January 2025. At the time, GTA VI was still due in autumn 2025, and most people thought a coin built around a video game would be forgotten within a month.

Then the first blow landed. In May 2025, Rockstar delayed the game to May 2026. Plenty of coins with GTA in the name died that week. We did not.

The community took the wheel and kept building. By May 2026 we had climbed above $2 million and stayed there for nearly two weeks, peaking at $2.84 million on 18 May.

Then came the hardest stretch of all. The game was delayed a second time, to November. The chart pulled back to around $410K by June, and the doubters were loud. Anyone looking for an excuse to leave had one. Most of us stayed, and by early November the chart had tripled off that low.

Then the vamps arrived. As the launch got closer, copycat coins appeared almost weekly, each one claiming to be the real GTA 6 coin. Some of them were built by people who sold their $GTA6 to fund them. Every single time, the holders here chose to stay.

Through two delays, an 85% drawdown and wave after wave of imitators, this community never broke. We now have more than 12,600 holders, burned liquidity, no dev and 658 days on chain.

Coins built on hype disappear when the hype fades. We were built on patience, and patience is exactly what GTA VI demanded of everyone.

Tomorrow, the game finally arrives. We have been waiting for it longer than almost anyone.

We will prevail. 🌴
